items.title: Deep Dive: Agentic Acceleration at Army Software Factory | DevCon 5
items.hover_description: A migration that should have taken months, completed in days. At DevCon 5, Chief Data Officer Marc Eskew and Deputy Chief Data Officer Alan Monaghan from Army Software Factory reveal how AI FDE supercharged team velocity for soldier developers, and break down the agentic approach that made it possible. Learn what AI-accelerated development looks like in practice, and how teams can apply that same acceleration at scale.
